config.decodedBitmapCache: none; each renderer call decodes and closes its own SHA-deduplicated bitmaps
config.processState: fresh Chrome process and profile per measured run; HTTP cache disabled; OS caches not purged
config.rendering: production modules, Canvas2D; drawSubmission is CPU submission; paint is two-rAF scheduling proxy

pilot.note: Four edits/selections per case: diagnostic only. Tool timing/phase/failure handling was corrected before the formal baseline. Pilot raw files remain in local work and are not capacity evidence.

candidates.note: Formal 12-run rejected experiment: same-size paint reuse plus global single-decoder correction; all raw arrays retained. Final removes reuse, retaining decoder and failure ownership fixes.

focusedBeforeFinal.note: Queue, render metrics/projection/paint ownership and fixtures; final full regression supersedes it.

testPolicy.idleSleepPrevention: command-scoped caffeinate -i, no system preferences modified

staticAuditHistory.result: initial link check reported two missing generated reports
staticAuditHistory.resolution: Copy generated doc/delivery reports into evidence first, then rerun links; no product source or runtime results changed.
